purpose: One-off personal/local/noncommercial historical input verification for C3; no model training, strategy activation, continuous collection or redistribution

operations.fields: provider-declared structured corporate-action fields; save returned schema and coverage limits
provider-declared adjustment dates/factors; no inference that unchanged factors prove all corporate actions absent

retention.rawStructuredResponses: local only, maximum 30 days; new versioned directory and manifest; no automatic deletion of existing archives
retention.gitEvidence: request parameters, returned schemas/counts, response hashes, comparisons and capability limits only; no raw market archive

runtime: temporary per-process opt-in only after owner source/use confirmation; leave .env.local, Compose and automations unchanged
limitations: stock_basic is not full historical universe/PIT membership
daily tradestatus cannot establish absence of intraday suspension
dividend/factor endpoints may not cover all corporate actions
this proposal does not authorize source use or positive replay
